parameters.query: SELECT row_to_json(t) as data FROM v_weekly_learning_data t WHERE week_start = DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW())::date - 7

SELECT t.template_type, t.variant, t.version, t.sends_count, t.response_rate, t.positive_rate, t.conversion_rate, t.system_prompt, t.user_prompt, t.notes FROM message_templates t WHERE t.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY t.template_type, t.variant

SELECT a.prospect_id, p.title, p.industry, p.company_size, p.location, p.profile_score, p.status, c.score as conv_score, c.intent, a.action_type, a.platform, a.status as action_status, a.template_id, a.ab_variant FROM actions a JOIN prospects p ON a.prospect_id = p.id LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.prospect_id = p.id WHERE a.created_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 week' AND a.created_at < DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) ORDER BY c.score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

parameters.query: INSERT INTO performance_insights (week_start, week_end, generated_at, total_outreach, total_responses, total_hot_leads, total_conversions, avg_response_rate, insights, templates_created) VALUES (DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW())::date - 7, DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW())::date - 1, NOW(), {{ $('Fetch métriques semaine (DB)').item.json.data.total_outreach || 0 }}, {{ $('Fetch métriques semaine (DB)').item.json.data.total_conversations || 0 }}, {{ $('Fetch métriques semaine (DB)').item.json.data.hot_leads || 0 }}, {{ $('Fetch métriques semaine (DB)').item.json.data.conversions || 0 }}, {{ $('Fetch métriques semaine (DB)').item.json.data.avg_conversation_score || 0 }}, '{{ $json.insights | string | replace("'", "''") }}'::jsonb, {{ $json.template_improvements.length }}) ON CONFLICT (week_start) DO UPDATE SET insights = EXCLUDED.insights, templates_created = EXCLUDED.templates_created, generated_at = NOW() RETURNING id
